features.heading: Citizen Service Centers & Digital Utilities

feat.assistant_desc: Ask in plain natural language. Get instant source-grounded answers with official GR references and application steps.
feat.eligibility_desc: Input your age, income, caste category, farmer/student status to instantly see all matching Maharashtra welfare schemes.
feat.schemes_desc: Verified database of Agriculture, Education, Women & Child, and Social Justice welfare programs with direct portal links.

feat.directory_desc: Locate Taluka Setu Suvidha Kendras, Collectorate contact numbers, working hours, and departmental nodal officer details.
assistant.header_subtitle: Accurate guidance backed by Maharashtra Government Resolutions (GR) & RTS Act standards

How may I assist you today?
